frozen_note: Written before any solver run. Thresholds are never changed after a result; a FAIL is kept.
solver: WaterLily.jl (Weymouth & Font 2025, CPC 109748, arXiv 2407.16032): 3-D incompressible Navier-Stokes, Cartesian grid, BDIM immersed boundary

C0_uniform_no_body.what: periodic-free uniform stream U=1 through an empty 32^3 box, 200 steps, Float64

C1_sphere_Re100.what: fixed sphere, Re = U D / nu = 100, domain (6D, 4D, 4D), centre at (1.5D, 2D, 2D), D = 8 and 16 cells, Float32, run to tU/D = 12, Cd = mean over tU/D in [8, 12] of total force_x / (0.5 U^2 pi D^2 / 4)
C1_sphere_Re100.reference: Schiller-Naumann correlation Cd = 24/Re (1 + 0.15 Re^0.687) = 1.092 at Re 100; recalled, not re-read from a primary source here
C1_sphere_Re100.band_reasoning: upper side wider for 4.9% blockage (pi/4 / 16) and coarse BDIM thickening; the band is set before the run

C2_mutant_viscosity_x4.what: same as C1 at D = 16 with nu x 4 (Re 25); reference correlation gives 2.27
C2_mutant_viscosity_x4.purpose: shows the C1 band can fail

fish_gates.geometry: fish3d 994aac4 candidate 4a3b912e: 13 closed STL components in metres, x snout->tail, y left, z dorsal
fish_gates.resolution_rule: a component is resolved only if its minimum thickness >= 2 grid cells; otherwise its forces are refused and it is labelled sub-grid
fish_gates.Re_rule: only Re (on total length) <= 2000 is run; flight Re (air ~1e5-2e5) is refused as unsupported by these grids
fish_gates.grid_rule: every fish force is reported beside the same case at half resolution, with relative difference; no convergence claim unless the pair differs by <= 10%
